physics_goals.value: Search for the top quark and study QCD and two-photon physics at TRISTAN energies

summary.plain: One of the three large general-purpose detectors at KEK's TRISTAN collider in Japan, built by a domestic Japanese team around a time-projection chamber in a superconducting solenoid. It measured hadron production and electroweak effects at the world's highest e+e- energies from 1987 to 1995.
summary.technical: TOPAZ at TRISTAN: domestic Japanese collaboration; superconducting solenoid with a time-projection tracking chamber; results include the total hadronic cross section and standard-model parameters (Phys. Lett. B 234 (1990) 525); TRISTAN programme May 1987 - December 1995.
